findings.title: Adjacent birth-tick contamination classifies a live original PID as reused/exited
findings.observed: Exact launch/code string and birth-window checks pass; recorded start_ticks=actual+1 remains inside launch5s tolerance, then != makes validate_exit declare our still-live helper PID exited. Full public prototype main emits PASS.
findings.required: A different current birth must be provably later than original witness capture time before declaring PID reuse. Same-era tick contradictions must reject; do not signal/kill producers.

findings.title: DINO qualified mode trusts an unbound self-declared Q and arbitrary hashed auxiliary bytes
findings.observed: The external binding contains only5 non-Q references. A DINO-labeled Q created after that binding, referencing FAILED/CLIP auxiliary JSON outside surrogate namespace, is accepted as qualified_pair and emits formal role-admission output.
findings.required: For this finite version, disable DINO qualified_pair before acquiring a slot and inside audit_owned, retaining only its prototype scope; otherwise require separately externally SHA-bound accepted DINO Q/prototype/aux semantic graph. CLIP qualified use should also carry explicit canonical0ae external Q reference.

independent_public_method: Only/tmp shadow roots and synthetic metadata. Literal namespace paths and fixture metadata trust-anchor hashes retargeted, validators/hash comparisons/107 reconstruction/public main unchanged. Fixed old318/shared12e/F implementation/harness-code byte digests remain exact, code payloads copied as data and never executed.
